moments.author: Sean Duffy
moments.quote: FAA systems are back to "full operations" after the nationwide ground stop caused by overloaded telecom maintenance.
moments.why: This post underpins explanation of the rare nationwide FAA ground stop—huge tech‑infrastructure fail dominating men's travel and tech conversations.

moments.author: AGTP Insights
moments.quote: Cyber source: Workday is down for numerous major corporations including Walmart, Target, Chipotle, Skechers, and others.
moments.why: Captures the widespread Workday outage impacting payroll/HR systems of big‑name employers—massively resonating with working men.

moments.author: Flighty
moments.quote: Nationwide Ground Stop until 22 Z [5PM ET] Due to ATC frequency outage, possibly isolated to in‑air centers, developing…

moments.author: James Spann
moments.quote: UPDATE — the nationwide ground stop has been LIFTED. It began at 2:54 this afternoon... over 4,500 flights canceled and 10,000 delayed.
moments.why: Provides a clear wrap‑up of the air‑travel chaos and scale—defining the viral moment men are discussing now.
